ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   B. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Love for parents? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Love for parents with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Love for parents.
   C. Use Love for parents to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Love for parents has no place in daily life.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic phrases? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic phrases has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Islamic phrases to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic phrases with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic phrases.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

7. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand.
   B. Use Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic etiquettes has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes.
   D. Use Islamic etiquettes to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:.
   C. Say Hadith on: has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on: to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Birth of Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Birth of Prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Birth of Prophet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Birth of Prophet has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Birth of Prophet.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Birth of Prophet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A — Apply the teaching of Love for parents with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. C — Apply the teaching of Islamic phrases with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

7. D — Apply the teaching of Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Birth of Prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A — Apply the teaching of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected Surah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Birth of Prophet; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on:; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
